items.title: How to Choose the Right Sandbox for AI Agents
items.en_title: How to Choose the Right Sandbox for AI Agents
items.en_oneliner: LangChain explains how to pick a sandbox for AI agents, weighing isolation, networking, and resource caps so safety does not get in the way of getting work done.
Claude Code 2.1.327 now confirms before /install-github-app touches a repository, and claude mcp add-json can take server JSON from stdin so tokens stay off the command line.

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
items.en_title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot now offers GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, OpenAI's newest models built for agentic coding and code review.

items.title: Release v0.28.1-preview.0
items.en_oneliner: A Qwen Code preview update that verifies scheduled triggers for managed agents and hardens state checks and container setup.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
items.en_title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot Fusion now ships with more models on more Copilot surfaces, plus results on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
items.en_title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
items.en_oneliner: The GitHub Copilot app now works with Azure DevOps repositories, GitHub Enterprise Server instances, and the browser, as part of a batch of Ignite releases.

items.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
items.en_title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot code review now scales its effort to each pull request — light for routine changes, deeper for complex ones — and catches leaked secrets more reliably.

items.title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
items.en_title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
items.en_oneliner: Microsoft's newest AI coding models, MAI Code 2 and its lighter sibling MAI Code 2 Flash, have landed in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
items.en_title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
items.en_oneliner: The JetBrains edition of GitHub Copilot now offers remote access, voice dictation that runs on your machine, and controls for browser use, alongside context usage shortcuts and a way to review past diffs.

items.title: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
items.en_title: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
items.en_oneliner: Companies can now pipe GitHub Copilot agent activity into Microsoft Agent 365 for unified auditing inside Microsoft's agent control plane.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
items.en_title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
items.en_oneliner: The GitHub Copilot CLI now lets you sign in with Microsoft Entra in public preview, quietly authenticating a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User.

items.title: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
items.en_title: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
items.en_oneliner: GitHub's new Repository insights page tracks what happens to Copilot code review feedback in each repo, starting with review outcomes.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
items.en_title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview, so you can keep tuning Copilot as prompts, models, skills, and tools evolve.

items.title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
items.en_title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith has added new access controls that help teams manage sensitive information inside trace data, so each member only sees what their permissions allow.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.en_oneliner: The new Astra and Sol variants of GPT-6.2 deliver better professional output, coding, and computer use at lower cost, now live across the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

items.title: Put Gemini to work for you
items.en_title: Put Gemini to work for you
items.en_oneliner: The Gemini app adds free task features: hand it something to get done, and it works on it in the background for you.

items.title: Introducing Devin Bots: from tasks to outcomes
items.en_title: Introducing Devin Bots: from tasks to outcomes
items.en_oneliner: Devin Bots act as engineering teammates accountable for outcomes, directing squads of Devins to finish the job.

items.title: What We’ve Learned Building Proactive Agents
items.en_title: What We've Learned Building Proactive Agents
items.en_oneliner: LangChain reviews lessons from building GTM Agent and Robin: proactive agents push toward goals on their own and ask for input only when needed, with memory and interaction design deciding success.
